description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeeTimesheetController class within the OrangeHRM time management plugin. It handles pre-render logic for employee timesheet views, managing access and setting up components with employee data based on incoming HTTP requests.

classes.name: EmployeeTimesheetController
classes.description: Controller class for handling the rendering of employee timesheets, managing access control and component setup based on request parameters.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Processes the HTTP request to prepare the component for rendering employee timesheets, setting properties such as start date and employee data, with access checks.
